notes: G2 wave 5, packet P79cfec2ff7. Printed: 'Put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to two target creatures. You may search your library and/or graveyard for a card named Basri, Devoted Paladin, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If you search your library this way, shuffle.' I target one creature (it gets one +1/+1 counter), accept the may and search only my graveyard (option 2): the Paladin goes from the graveyard to my hand. I did not search my library, so it is NOT shuffled: it keeps its setup order (the runner's six fillers on top, then Keep Two, Keep One). hand after = drawn + Paladin = 2.
